newsitem.title: UK: MY Holdings in talks on Malbak unbundling.
newsitem.headline: MY Holdings in talks on Malbak unbundling.

text.p: Britain's M.Y. Holdings Plc said on Thursday it was consulting with South Africa's Malbak Ltd regarding various alternatives for the sale of the industrial holding group's 64-percent stake in M.Y.
The expected sale is part of Malbak's previously-announced plan to unbundle its assets.

"The boards of both companies are continuing to examine various options which, it is expected, will take some considerable time to crystallise into an acceptable solution," said M.Y. Holdings, a maker of packaging products.
M.Y. added that the November 29 deadline set by Malbak for indicative offers for its assets was not applicable to its holding in the company.
M.Y. shares fell 7.0p to 111-1/2p in morning trade.
M.Y. said the alternatives being reviewed centred on the "orderly distribution" of Malbak's stake in the company.
Earlier this week, Malbak said M.Y. would be treated as an unlisted unit since shares in the London-listed company could not be distributed to shareholders due to exchange controls.
Malbak said the most likely scenario was for its unlisted companies to be sold, the majority for cash, with the proceeds distributed to shareholders.
For its part, M.Y. said the talks would not affect its business.

"M.Y.'s expansion and investment plans remain unchanged and will underpin our ability to provide high service levels and low cost production to our selected markets -- it's business as usual," chief executive John Monks said in a statement.
